content:
jess: FYI PT-8330 hiccup: multiple assessors hit ephemeral role request at T0, KMS proxy returned 429s and several evidence uploads failed. Need a short mitigation + retest plan.
iain: logs? env?
jess: prod-readroom. logs show `KMSProxy:429` + `upstream_rate_limit`. attached sample req_id: r-0a1b2c.
nora: short-term: throttle grants and add jitter. also add ingest-side dedupe (sha256 + assessor) for 10m window to avoid dup uploads.
iain: I can add an SQS gate with consumer jitter 100-300ms and concurrency cap 40. deploy to staging in ~90m behind ff.
ops-bot: Reminder: playbook /runbooks/pt-access.md -> coord with pt-coordinator before changing gating.
pt-coordinator: I'll pause auto-slot assignment and assign manual 10-min slots to assessors once staging metrics look good.
jess: temp mitigation: tell assessors to reduce retries. Nora, can you add a pre-ingest 409 on dup?
nora: yes. pseudocode: `if cache.exists(k): audit('dup'); return 409`
iain: opened PR `sqs-kms-gate`. enabling 20% canary on staging.
pt-coordinator: creating retest queue entries in PT-8330 and notifying assessors.
ops-bot: Add Splunk alert: `KMSProxy:5xx_rate > 2%` and `evidence.duplicate_detected`.
jess: action owners: Iain = gate; Nora = dedupe; PT-coordinator = manual slots + comms. Post here when live. :thumbsup:
